options.content:
### ℹ️ Industrial Protocol PCAP Analyzer (FAT/SAT Telemetry)
**Select a session** using the `$session` dropdown above to isolate telemetry from a specific test run.
> **Virtual-Clock Note:** PCAP packet captures reflect historical timestamps recorded during physical or simulated testing. Consult the **Capture Start** and **Capture End** columns in the table below to adjust Grafana's time range picker (top right) to match the capture window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  s.name AS "Session Name",
  s.pcap_file_name AS "PCAP File",
  s.status AS "Status",
  s.timeout_threshold_ms || ' ms' AS "Timeout Limit",
  to_char(MIN(r.timestamp), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS TZ') AS "Capture Start",
  to_char(MAX(r.timestamp), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS TZ') AS "Capture End",
  to_char(MAX(r.timestamp) - MIN(r.timestamp), 'HH24:MI:SS.US') AS "Duration",
  COUNT(r.frame_number) AS "Total Tx"
FROM test_sessions s
LEFT JOIN red_transactions r ON s.id = r.session_id
WHERE s.id = '$session'
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.pcap_file_name, s.status, s.timeout_threshold_ms;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Total Transactions"
FROM red_transactions
WHERE session_id = '$session'
  AND device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND ('$direction' = 'All' OR direction = '$direction');

SELECT
  ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_error) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 2) AS "Error Rate"
FROM red_transactions
WHERE session_id = '$session'
  AND device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND ('$direction' = 'All' OR direction = '$direction');

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)::numeric, 2) AS "Avg Latency"
FROM red_transactions
WHERE session_id = '$session'
  AND device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND ('$direction' = 'All' OR direction = '$direction')
  AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  ROUND(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms)::numeric, 2) AS "P95 Latency"
FROM red_transactions
WHERE session_id = '$session'
  AND device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND ('$direction' = 'All' OR direction = '$direction')
  AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT td.id) AS "Monitored Tags"
FROM tag_definitions td
JOIN device_pairs dp ON td.device_pair_id = dp.id
WHERE dp.session_id = '$session';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Captured Commands"
FROM captured_command_events
WHERE session_id = '$session'
  AND device_pair_id IN ($device_pair);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Unmapped Registers"
FROM modbus_raw_unmapped
WHERE session_id = '$session'
  AND device_pair_id IN ($device_pair);

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, $__interval),
  dp.name || ' (' || r.direction || ')' AS metric,
  COUNT(*) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS value
FROM red_transactions r
JOIN device_pairs dp ON r.device_pair_id = dp.id
WHERE r.session_id = '$session'
  AND r.device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND ('$direction' = 'All' OR r.direction = '$direction')
  AND $__timeFilter(r.timestamp)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, $__interval),
  error_type AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM red_transactions
WHERE session_id = '$session'
  AND device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND ('$direction' = 'All' OR direction = '$direction')
  AND is_error = TRUE
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, $__interval),
  ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)::numeric, 2) AS "Avg Duration (ms)",
  ROUND(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms)::numeric, 2) AS "P95 Duration (ms)",
  ROUND(MAX(duration_ms)::numeric, 2) AS "Max Duration (ms)"
FROM red_transactions
WHERE session_id = '$session'
  AND device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND ('$direction' = 'All' OR direction = '$direction')
  AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  status_code AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM red_transactions
WHERE session_id = '$session'
  AND device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND ('$direction' = 'All' OR direction = '$direction')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY status_code
ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT
  dp.protocol || ' FC ' || r.function_code AS "Function Code",
  COUNT(*) AS "Transactions"
FROM red_transactions r
JOIN device_pairs dp ON r.device_pair_id = dp.id
WHERE r.session_id = '$session'
  AND r.device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND ('$direction' = 'All' OR r.direction = '$direction')
  AND $__timeFilter(r.timestamp)
GROUP BY dp.protocol, r.function_code
ORDER BY "Transactions" DESC;

SELECT
  r.frame_number AS "Frame #",
  to_char(r.timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS "Timestamp",
  dp.name AS "Device Pair",
  r.direction AS "Direction",
  r.transaction_id AS "Tx ID",
  r.function_code AS "FC",
  ROUND(r.duration_ms::numeric, 2) AS "Duration (ms)",
  r.error_type AS "Error Type",
  r.status_code AS "Status Code"
FROM red_transactions r
JOIN device_pairs dp ON r.device_pair_id = dp.id
WHERE r.session_id = '$session'
  AND r.device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND ('$direction' = 'All' OR r.direction = '$direction')
  AND (r.is_error = TRUE OR r.duration_ms > 100)
  AND $__timeFilter(r.timestamp)
ORDER BY r.timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Industrial Process Telemetry & Tag Time Series

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(tv.packet_timestamp, $__interval),
  td.tag_name || COALESCE(' [' || td.engineering_units || ']', '') AS metric,
  AVG(tv.scaled_numeric_value) AS value
FROM tag_values tv
JOIN tag_definitions td ON tv.tag_id = td.id
WHERE tv.session_id = '$session'
  AND td.device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND tv.tag_id IN ($tag)
  AND tv.scaled_numeric_value IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(tv.packet_timestamp)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(tv.packet_timestamp, $__interval),
  td.tag_name AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (tv.packet_timestamp - tv.event_timestamp)) * 1000.0)::numeric, 2) AS value
FROM tag_values tv
JOIN tag_definitions td ON tv.tag_id = td.id
WHERE tv.session_id = '$session'
  AND td.device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND tv.tag_id IN ($tag)
  AND tv.event_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(tv.packet_timestamp)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: DNP3 RTU Event vs Packet Latency Skew (Δt)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  tv.packet_timestamp AS "time",
  td.tag_name AS metric,
  CASE WHEN tv.boolean_value = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value
FROM tag_values tv
JOIN tag_definitions td ON tv.tag_id = td.id
WHERE tv.session_id = '$session'
  AND td.device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND tv.tag_id IN ($tag)
  AND tv.boolean_value IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(tv.packet_timestamp)
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  tv.frame_number AS "Frame #",
  to_char(tv.packet_timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS "Packet Time",
  to_char(tv.event_timestamp, 'HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS "RTU Event Time",
  td.tag_name AS "Tag Name",
  td.protocol_address AS "Address",
  COALESCE(tv.scaled_numeric_value::text, tv.boolean_value::text, tv.raw_hex) AS "New Value",
  td.engineering_units AS "Units",
  COALESCE(tv.quality_flags, 'NORMAL') AS "Quality Flags"
FROM tag_values tv
JOIN tag_definitions td ON tv.tag_id = td.id
WHERE tv.session_id = '$session'
  AND td.device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND tv.tag_id IN ($tag)
  AND tv.is_value_change = TRUE
  AND $__timeFilter(tv.packet_timestamp)
ORDER BY tv.packet_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
  td.tag_name AS "Tag Name",
  td.protocol_address AS "Protocol Address",
  td.data_type AS "Type",
  td.engineering_units AS "Units",
  td.scale_multiplier AS "Scale",
  td.scale_offset AS "Offset",
  td.initial_scaled_numeric_value AS "Initial Scaled (T0)",
  td.initial_boolean_value AS "Initial Bool (T0)",
  td.initial_raw_hex AS "Initial Raw Hex",
  COUNT(tv.frame_number) AS "Observations",
  COUNT(tv.frame_number) FILTER (WHERE tv.is_value_change) AS "Transitions"
FROM tag_definitions td
LEFT JOIN tag_values tv ON td.id = tv.tag_id AND tv.session_id = '$session'
WHERE td.device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
GROUP BY td.id, td.tag_name, td.protocol_address, td.data_type, td.engineering_units,
         td.scale_multiplier, td.scale_offset, td.initial_scaled_numeric_value,
         td.initial_boolean_value, td.initial_raw_hex
ORDER BY td.tag_name;

panels.title: Tag Manifest & T0 Baseline State Catalog

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS "time",
  protocol || ': ' || target_address || ' (' || COALESCE(control_action, command_type) || ')' AS metric,
  1 AS value
FROM captured_command_events
WHERE session_id = '$session'
  AND device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  command_type AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM captured_command_events
WHERE session_id = '$session'
  AND device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY command_type
ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT
  COALESCE(control_action, 'MODBUS_NUMERIC') AS "Control Action",
  COUNT(*) AS "Count"
FROM captured_command_events
WHERE session_id = '$session'
  AND device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY control_action
ORDER BY "Count" DESC;

SELECT
  c.frame_number AS "Frame #",
  to_char(c.timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS "Timestamp",
  dp.name AS "Device Pair",
  c.protocol AS "Protocol",
  c.command_type AS "Command Type",
  c.target_address AS "Target Address",
  COALESCE(c.control_action, '-') AS "Action",
  c.command_count AS "Count",
  c.pulse_on_ms AS "Pulse On (ms)",
  c.pulse_off_ms AS "Pulse Off (ms)",
  c.unscaled_command_value AS "Value",
  '0x' || encode(c.raw_pdu_bytes, 'hex') AS "Raw PDU Hex"
FROM captured_command_events c
JOIN device_pairs dp ON c.device_pair_id = dp.id
WHERE c.session_id = '$session'
  AND c.device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND $__timeFilter(c.timestamp)
ORDER BY c.frame_number ASC
LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Captured Control Commands Replay Audit Log

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, $__interval),
  register_type AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM modbus_raw_unmapped
WHERE session_id = '$session'
  AND device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND ('$direction' = 'All' OR direction = '$direction')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Unmapped Register Poll Rate Over Time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  'Unit ' || unit_id || ' | ' || register_type || ' [' || register_offset || ']' AS "Register",
  COUNT(*) AS "Poll Count"
FROM modbus_raw_unmapped
WHERE session_id = '$session'
  AND device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND ('$direction' = 'All' OR direction = '$direction')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY unit_id, register_type, register_offset
ORDER BY "Poll Count" DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT
  u.frame_number AS "Frame #",
  to_char(u.timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS "Timestamp",
  dp.name AS "Device Pair",
  u.direction AS "Direction",
  u.unit_id AS "Unit ID",
  u.register_type AS "Register Type",
  u.register_offset AS "Offset",
  u.raw_value_hex AS "Raw Hex Value"
FROM modbus_raw_unmapped u
JOIN device_pairs dp ON u.device_pair_id = dp.id
WHERE u.session_id = '$session'
  AND u.device_pair_id IN ($device_pair)
  AND ('$direction' = 'All' OR u.direction = '$direction')
  AND $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
ORDER BY u.frame_number DESC
LIMIT 100;

list.definition: SELECT id AS __value, name || ' (' || pcap_file_name || ' [' || status || '])' AS __text FROM test_sessions ORDER BY ingested_at DESC;
list.label: Test Session
list.name: session
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, name || ' (' || pcap_file_name || ' [' || status || '])' AS __text FROM test_sessions ORDER BY ingested_at DESC;

list.definition: SELECT id AS __value, name || ' [' || protocol || '] (' || client_ip::text || ' -> ' || server_ip::text || ')' AS __text FROM device_pairs WHERE session_id = '$session' ORDER BY name;
list.label: Device Pair
list.name: device_pair
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, name || ' [' || protocol || '] (' || client_ip::text || ' -> ' || server_ip::text || ')' AS __text FROM device_pairs WHERE session_id = '$session' ORDER BY name;

list.definition: SELECT id AS __value, tag_name || ' (' || protocol_address || COALESCE(' [' || engineering_units || ']', '') || ')' AS __text FROM tag_definitions WHERE device_pair_id IN ($device_pair) ORDER BY tag_name;
list.label: Tag / Signal
list.name: tag
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, tag_name || ' (' || protocol_address || COALESCE(' [' || engineering_units || ']', '') || ')' AS __text FROM tag_definitions WHERE device_pair_id IN ($device_pair) ORDER BY tag_name;
